signature.name: VTask.glue
signature.type: {α : Type u_1} -> Ordnode α → Ordnode α → Ordnode α

conventions.statement: VTask.glue Ordnode.nil r = r for any r
conventions.note: When the left argument is nil, the right tree is returned unchanged.

conventions.statement: VTask.glue (Ordnode.node s ll lx lr) Ordnode.nil = Ordnode.node s ll lx lr
conventions.note: When the right argument is nil and the left is a node, the left tree is returned unchanged.

facts.statement: ∀ (l r : Ordnode ℕ) (o₁ o₂ : WithBot ℕ) (x : ℕ), Ordnode.Valid' o₁ l x → Ordnode.Valid' x r o₂ → Ordnode.BalancedSz (Ordnode.size l) (Ordnode.size r) → Ordnode.size (VTask.glue l r) = Ordnode.size l + Ordnode.size r
